data.description:
**The Thrill of the Fight 2 is available now in Early Access! We're looking forward to your feedback as we continue to add to the game. Currently only online multiplayer is available; offline single player is planned for 2025. Some game features are yet to be added and you may encounter bugs. Follow our development roadmap at thethrillofthefight2.com**


The fully reimagined sequel to the greatest VR boxing game ever made is now available. Glove up your fully personalizable avatar and test your skill while working up a sweat in the new online player versus player mode. Challenge friends or enter the ring through skill-based matchmaking as you battle through breathtaking arenas.

**Available now:**

**Immersive Online Multiplayer**: Skill-based matchmaking and direct matches with friends.

**Exceptionally High-Fidelity Boxing Experience**: Authentic, life-like physics for the world’s most realistic boxing simulation.

**Stunning Graphics and Realistic Immersion**: Breathtaking visuals and audio make you feel like you’re truly in the action.

**Represent Yourself in the Ring**: Personalize your character's facial features, gender, skin tone, and body type.

**Customize Your Gear**: Select your gloves, shorts, shoes, and more including premium gear coming later.

**Spectator App**: Gather your friends to watch your matches with a "live sports" style camera on a connected PC.

Join your fellow fans on our Discord: discord.gg/TheThrillOfTheFight2

changelog.change_log:
0.1.20 Patch Notes
- Crowd audio now plays when the server counts a hit from the opponent's perspective, instead of when you see a hit from your perspective.
- Fixed an issue that could cause punishment to max out with one punch.
- Fixed an issue that could cause your damage for a round to show as zero after your score a punishment knockdown.
- Fixed an issue that could cause errors when players joined a lobby, requiring the lobby to be remade.
- Updated recenter logic to bring the standing circle to the player's in-game body instead of moving the player's in-game body to the standing circle.
- KOs and the third knockdown of a TKO now show up in the knockdown count on the scorecard.

0.1.19 Patch Notes
- Fixed an issue that was causing the Damage Update V2 toggle in Training to act incorrectly
- The beacon list that appears while searching for a Ranked match is now scrollable
- Small visual fixes for the stun effect

0.1.18 Patch Notes
- The new damage update "v1" has been enabled in Ranked and in Training
- The next round of damage testing "v2" is now available in Custom matches and in Training
- Updated visual effect that plays when you get hit to better convey how much damage you received
- Added more networking information to the Ranked menu when searching for a match
- Reduced the time it takes to check regional ping when starting search for a ranked match

0.1.17 Patch Notes
Added the experimental damage system update that can be enabled in custom matches and against the training dummy. Please try it out and give us feedback!
Slightly reduced body damage.
Increased requirements to get a punishment knockdown.
Standing Mode joystick movement is no longer blocked if you are outside of the shared play area during a match. This will not allow you to exit the play area!
Improved a portion of our netcode that was failing for players in some regions when they tried to join a match.
Fixed a rare issue where players could get stuck after a knockdown.
Your ping that is shown during a match now shows the full return trip time to and from your opponent.
Adjusted some IK settings to improve how the body looks in certain positions.

Fix for delayed movement issue that has been occurring during some matches
The counter-punch bonus damage system is no longer an optional custom match option and has been made part of the core game mechanics
Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause the mark to render incorrectly at the end of a match
Made a small tweak to damage to reduce huge unexpected spikes (much larger damage update coming soon)
Fixed ping display to show the packet travel time to the other player instead of just to the server

0.1.16 Patch Notes
Added the experimental damage system update that can be enabled in custom matches and against the training dummy. Please try it out and give us feedback!
Slightly reduced body damage.
Increased requirements to get a punishment knockdown.
Standing Mode joystick movement is no longer blocked if you are outside of the shared play area during a match. This will not allow you to exit the play area!
Improved a portion of our netcode that was failing for players in some regions when they tried to join a match.
Fixed a rare issue where players could get stuck after a knockdown.
Your ping that is shown during a match now shows the full return trip time to and from your opponent. 
Adjusted some IK settings to improve how the body looks in certain positions.

- Added an experimental counter-punch system that can be enabled in custom matches. Please try it out and give us feedback!
- The maximum allowed wrist angle has been increased significantly.
- Your corner color will now appear on the floor marks during a match.
- Fixed an issue that gave incorrect match results when one player inflicted overwhelming amounts of damage.
- Fixed an issue that was causing some players to get stuck when starting ranked match searches.
- Errors with the ranked match search are more verbose for easier issue reporting.

0.1.13
- First steps to reduce damage on some types of windmill and hammer punches.
- Prevented hits from causing double damage when going from head to body.
- Fixed issue causing arms to calibrate incorrectly based on player height. Players will be asked to calibrate again on next startup.
- Corrected issue that would immediately disconnect spectators.
- Reduced damage for chest hits.
- Allow easier matching for players at the extreme ends of the ratings range

0.1.12 Patch Notes
- Standing mode no longer restricts your in-game body to the green circle
- Addressed an issue making vibration strength weaker than it should have been
- Players will now timeout with a loss if they stop sending packets to the server for 15 seconds (was previously around 60s). If your opponent freezes, wait it out for 15 seconds.
- Made a couple of changes to address an issue with the boxing dummy where your hand might make contact with the dummy a second time after you punch and show a low damage value. We now show the highest damage you did to the dummy during a 1s period and we have disabled damage to the dummy's shoulders.

0.1.11 Patch Notes
Added a clear indicator to the Main Menu to display what Movement Mode is currently active.
Improved clarity for Play Area requirements in the Roomscale menu.
Increased default standing mode circle size from 0.5 to 0.6.
